name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Words on one hairline, the current one underlined in ink.
use: Switching between sibling pages, or between the panels of one page. As links in a nav, the current one has aria-current="page" and no script is needed. For panels in place, the row is a role="tablist" of role="tab" buttons with aria-selected, and a script switches the panels.

instead.when: It is a compact choice among a few values
The destinations are the main ones of a small-screen app
The destinations stack in a sidebar

keyboard.action: As links, every tab is a tab stop
In a tablist, with a script that keeps one tab stop: move to the tab before or after
In a tablist, with that script: move to the first or the last tab

platform.fallback: Each current tab draws its own underline, which does not glide

classes.name: tabs
classes.description: The hairline row, on a nav with a label or on a role="tablist". It scrolls sideways when the tabs do not fit

classes.name: tabs-item
classes.description: A tab: a link with aria-current="page", or a role="tab" button with aria-selected

classes.name: tabs-sm
classes.description: Compact tabs, 36px tall with 13px labels; the default is 44px with 14px labels

states.name: current
states.description: On a link: strong ink and the underline

states.name: selected
states.description: On a role="tab" button: strong ink and the underline

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link: disabled ink, and the tab stops answering the pointer

example: Overview Activity Settings
